lever.change: Implement BREACH-DOCTOR-1 v1 as ONE package: (1) migration migrations/2026-10-26-breach-doctor.sql (APPLY-BY ci, DB qnfo-audit, single-line Rollback, BACKUP header only if it DELETEs/DROPs): tables breach_diagnoses, breach_diagnosis_events, breach_playbooks; views v_breach_diagnosis_current, v_breach_owner (owner_kind: code-task line | live code task | live work claim | breach doctor | owner card (identity-bound) | NULL, per architecture section 5; Phase A creates the view only, v_issue_age_ladder is NOT replaced), v_breach_doctor_status; ops_config switches breach_doctor (off|measure|on, seeded 'on'), breach_doctor_ai (seeded 'off', v1 makes no model call), breach_doctor_max_cases/_max_actions/_budget_ms/_min_age_h/_playbook_cooldown_min (30); metric_registry rows + analytics_metric_triggers for breaches_undiagnosed_over_60m (target 0), breaches_auto_remediated_24h (target >= 12), doctor_actions_failed_24h (target 0), doctor_tick_age_min (<= 15, trigger > 30), doctor_taint_violations_24h (0); control_registry, spof_registry, belief_registry rows, failure_modes + fm- detectors (fm-breach-doctor-stalled), a decision_log row (real columns, append-only so the Rollback leaves it); seed playbooks CM-R1, CM-R2, CM-R3, CM-R5 converted to PER-ISSUE form (each action statement binds ?1 = issue_id and adds AND a.id = ?1 or equivalent; trigger_sql returns issue_id, subject, facts_json) with revert_sql and verify_sql, and a generic 'playbook-gap' rule. (2) the engine: a new block between the lines '// ---- BREACH-DOCTOR-1:BEGIN ----' and '// ---- BREACH-DOCTOR-1:END ----' in qnfo-fleet-control/worker.js, called as ctx.waitUntil(breachDoctorTick(env, ...)) from the */10 slot of scheduledOnce next to remediationContractsTick on EVERY 10-minute tick, plus VERSION minor bump (new capability), mirror deployed-current.worker.js identical, release note per VERSION-LINE-NOTES-1. (3) tests: qnfo-fleet-control/breach-doctor.test.mjs (replay the block between the markers against an in-memory node:sqlite D1 stub with the real column lists, as trigger-parse.test.mjs does) and migrations/breach-doctor.test.mjs (header, replay no-op, Rollback, seed playbooks over fixtures, per-issue forms touch only the named issue). BINDING SIMPLIFICATIONS (decided by the session; record them in the decision_log row): S1 playbooks are data: breach_playbooks(rule_id PK, version, family, cause_class, trigger_sql, action_sql JSON array of 1-6 statements, revert_sql JSON array, verify_sql, min_ladder, max_per_tick, max_per_day, enabled, mode measure|on, created_at, note). The engine validates every trigger/verify/action/revert statement before it runs: trigger_sql and verify_sql are one read-only SELECT (the remediation tick's __RT_WRITE_KW guard); each action/revert statement is exactly one INSERT or UPDATE on an allowlisted table (issue_triage, agent_issues (UPDATE only), remediation_contracts, issue_plans, ops_config, human_actions) with no semicolon, no DELETE/DROP/ALTER/CREATE/PRAGMA/ATTACH, no INSERT INTO agent_issues or code_tasks, and no reference to the free-text columns description, exceptions_json, cloud_ops_events.text/meta (taint rule: free text never flows into an issue, probe, task or prompt). A rule that fails validation is skipped with a taint-drop event and counted in doctor_taint_violations_24h. S2 action kinds in CODE are closed: 'sql' (validated playbook statements), 'file-issue' (title prefix 'BREACH-DOCTOR-1: <rule_id> <enum subject>', constant description built from enums/ids, deduped on the open title, source qnfo-fleet-control), 'owner-card' (human_actions row whose why carries 'IDENTITY-BOUND: <enum reason>', a default in effect and a closing probe). No model call in v1. S3 safety: a playbook younger than breach_doctor_playbook_cooldown_min (default 30, max 120) runs in measure (writes the would-do diagnosis only); a rule with 2 or more failed/reverted diagnoses in 24 h demotes itself to mode 'measure' (event + failure_modes recurrence); per-rule max_per_tick/max_per_day; a live claim in work_claims on issue:<id> skips the case; every applied action stores revert_sql in the ledger and writes a decision_log row (actor 'qnfo-fleet-control:breach-doctor', predicted_outcome = verify expectation) and a breach_diagnosis_events row; lease_until never more than 120 minutes ahead and renewed only by a progress event. S4 classification of EVERY unowned open issue: for open agent_issues older than breach_doctor_min_age_h (default 8) with no doer in the three-way EXISTS of v_breach_owner, ordered critical, high, medium, low then created_at (PRIORITY-QUEUE-1), up to max_cases per tick, the engine writes one breach_diagnoses row with family (from a CODE table of title prefixes/sources; unknown = 'other'), cause_class from the playbook that matched or 'unclassified', and facts_json built ONLY from numbers, ids and enum codes (plan outcome, plan reason CODE from a regex enum, contract status/last_verdict, code task status/attempts, ages); an unclassified family files at most ONE 'BREACH-DOCTOR-1: playbook gap <family>' issue per family per 24 h to the code loop (never to the owner), carrying the counts and the enum facts, so the fleet extends its own playbooks by migration. S5 verify: for applied cases read verify_sql; two consecutive passes = verified (state verified, verified_at set); a failed verify = state failed with an error_code enum, attempts+1; 3 failures file a BREACH-DOCTOR-1: self issue. S6 observability/order: write the metrics FIRST each tick (worker code, so a dead heartbeat cannot hide), single-flight via a loop_lock row k='breach-doctor' ttl 4 minutes, kill switch ops_config breach_doctor=off returns before any write, per-tick budget breach_doctor_budget_ms (default 20000, no new case after 85%), candidate query must read <= 60k rows (do NOT read v_issue_age_ladder per tick; it reads ~367k rows). S7 do NOT add a D1 trigger on fleet_tick or any trigger chain (FLEET-TICK-SPLIT-1, SQLITE_NOMEM outage). The second path (qnfo-cloud-ops watch job) and the dashboard Diagnose verb are separate packages: do not touch qnfo-cloud-ops or qnfo-fleet-dashboard. Do not change PLAN_TRUSTED, code_merge_trusted_sources or any planner file.
